title: Niagara Falls Tour: Power Station, Illumination Tower & Dinner
includes: Niagara Parks Power Station's "The Tunnel" (Admission Included)
Narrated driving tour through the Niagara Parkway and Dufferin Islands Winter Festival of Lights
Toronto Central Meeting Point Pick-up and Drop-off (If option is selected)
Hotel pickup and drop-off in Niagara Falls Canada or USA (If option is selected)
"I Lit Up Niagara Falls" commemorative certificate
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your evening begins with convenient pick-up from your Niagara Falls, Canada hotel, Niagara Falls, USA accommodation, or a central Toronto meeting point. Sit back and relax as your small-group tour travels to Niagara Falls for an unforgettable night experience.

Upon arrival, enjoy a narrated drive along the scenic Niagara Parkway, where your guide will point out landmarks while you take in views of the illuminated Falls.

Next, enjoy a 3-course Fallsview dinner at a local Niagara Falls restaurant.

After dinner, step inside the Illumination Tower, where you’ll have the rare opportunity to change the colours that illuminate Niagara Falls.

You will then visit the historic Niagara Parks Power Station, where you’ll walk through the impressive Tunnel leading to the river’s edge at the base of the Falls.

Your evening concludes with a scenic drive through the Dufferin Islands before returning to your accommodation.
